dispositions.topic_text: Accepted Registry base-URL forms and path-joining semantics
dispositions.what: _registry_url: which non-blank http(s) forms are usable (query, fragment, surrounding whitespace, malformed port) is the accepted gateway's; the checks pin each form's outcome

dispositions.topic_text: How binary read and response bounds remain consistent when configuration changes after startup
dispositions.reason: The environment of a running process does not change after start: the service and the command are started with their environment and nothing in the portal sets a variable, so the start-up comparison of the two binary bounds holds for every later read.
